title: 2027 Home & Outdoor Living Show of Greater Springfield
seo_title: 2027 Home & Outdoor Living Show in Springfield, MO
description: This annual home and outdoor living show lets visitors meet local home professionals face-to-face, including builders, remodelers, designers, landscapers and other home industry experts. Explore products, services and the latest home trends, get expert advice during Shop Talks, and find ideas for remodeling, building a new home or refreshing an outdoor space; families are welcome, children under 12 and veterans are admitted free, and parking is free. It takes place January 8, 2027 (time TBD) at Wilson Logistics Arena, 3001 N Grant Ave in Springfield, MO.
